project_type: Next.js 16.3.8 App Router web app (React 19, TypeScript 5 strict, Tailwind CSS v4). KlimaGuard PH climate assistant. src/ layout with @/* -> src/* alias.
build_system: npm scripts. No tailwind.config.js — Tailwind v4 theme is inline via @theme + CSS variables in src/app/globals.css, with @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)) for class-based dark mode. No test runner configured.
test_command: none configured — verification is lint + build only
verification_instructions: On Windows PowerShell chain with ';' not '&&': run `npm run lint ; npm run build`. Both must exit 0 with no new errors. Do NOT run `npm run dev` as a blocking task. Do NOT create git commits (hackathon leaves the tree modified).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell; chain commands with ';'. Do not block on `npm run dev`. Do not modify the managed <!-- BEGIN:nextjs-agent-rules --> block in AGENTS.md. Framework is Next.js 16 (not 14/15) — route-transition APIs differ; relevant docs are node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/template.md and node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md.
contribution_requirements: Functional components only, one per file, with exported I-prefixed TypeScript props interfaces. No `any`. Tailwind utility classes only (no inline styles, no CSS modules); arbitrary values like bg-[#1A365D] allowed, prefer promoting repeats to @theme vars. No console.log. API calls wrapped in try/catch with Filipino fallback. User-facing text defaults to Filipino; English is the i18n fallback via the EN/FIL toggle. Dark mode via `dark:` prefix. Keep WCAG AA contrast both themes.
key_patterns: i18n: useLanguage() from @/components/common exposes { language, setLanguage, t }. t(key, vars) interpolates {var}. Dictionaries src/lib/i18n/{fil,en}.ts (base, 624 keys each) and src/lib/i18n/{munFil,munEn}.ts (municipal, 392 keys each, spread into fil/en). Keys MUST stay at exact parity between a dict and its mirror — Record<ITranslationKey,string> typing fails the build otherwise. Theme tokens: brand Navy #1A365D, Teal #38B2AC, Alert Red #E53E3E (emergency ONLY). CSS vars in globals.css: --app-bg --surface-2 --card --text --text-muted --navy --teal --alert and command-center --cmd-surface --cmd-tile --cmd-accent --cmd-heading --cmd-muted. Fonts: font-heading (Montserrat), font-sans (Lexend), font-ui (Poppins on buttons/inputs/nav/labels). Auth: useAuth() from @/components/common returns { session, ready }; session.role in 'lgu'|'barangay'|'resident'|'farmer'; officials = lgu|barangay (mirrors OFFICIAL_ROLES in src/lib/auth/scope.ts, which is server-only — do NOT import it client-side, replicate the two-role check inline). Icons via <Icon name=... size=.../> from @/components/common; IconName type exported there.
